definitions.list_name: An identifying reference to a general item/task list, an event calendar or schedule functioning as a collection, or a contact-record collection/address book. The collection role must be expressed; an item, activity, scheduling verb, punctuality property or generic storage container alone is insufficient. Music playlists and mail folders alone retain their specialized roles unless a separate general item/task-list role is expressed. Apply request-relevant scope.

list_name: Identify the collection role from the full utterance, not from a proper title or native intent. My calendar, the schedule queried for its entries, contacts used for record lookup/editing, address book and named shopping/task lists can qualify without recovering all entries.

A calendar or schedule counts when used as an event/appointment collection, including asking what is on it or adding, deleting or clearing entries. Schedule as an operation verb, on schedule as punctuality, or a single appointment by itself does not establish a collection.

Contacts counts when expressed as a contact-record collection, for example lookup in contacts or add an address to contacts. People described as contacts without a collection relation do not automatically qualify. A contact collection does not by itself imply a human person or an attribute field.

Music playlists, a music library and mail-storage folders/inbox are not automatically general lists merely because they contain items. A separate expressed item/task inventory may coexist, such as a list of books to order or an explicitly managed list of recordings; keep particular playlist and mail-folder policies independent.

A verb asking to list results alone does not establish an identifying collection reference. An explicitly requested new list with a name or organizing description can qualify; generic tasks, outstanding work or things to buy alone do not establish a list object.

When the input clearly supplies only an operation, item or non-list role, list_name is absent. Keep unavailable only for genuine unresolved collection identity/scope, malformed wording, or bare-fragment request relevance; do not infer missing context from native labels.

reading: All151 native list sources,387 calendar/schedule-pattern sources and48 contact-collection-pattern sources read. Diagnostic retrieval is not an automatic label rule.

upstream_evidence.interpretation: Examples distinguish lists, calendar events and contact fields. Explicit calendar/contact collection inclusion is a project semantic choice, not identical native span tagging.
